author: Jiawei Zhang
task_instruction:
Claim construction in Williams IP (case 2024-CV-0493 before Judge Sandra Okafor) is going to be the whole ballgame, so let's get this brief right. Review matter M-2024-006 for the patent claims at issue and the parties' proposed constructions. The brief must walk through each disputed term under a claim construction framework grounded in Phillips v. AWH. Search for Federal Circuit claim construction decisions — focus on cases involving software method patents and means-plus-function limitations. Read the key opinions carefully because I want to understand how the court applied the intrinsic evidence hierarchy. Check the relevant patent statutes, particularly 35 U.S.C. 112, and any recent amendments. Look at any existing documents in the matter file for prior claim charts or prosecution history excerpts we can reference. Draft the brief, make sure every case citation is verified, and save your completed claim construction brief as a draft in the matter system under matter M-2024-006.
Title the brief heading 'Claim Construction Brief: Williams IP v. PatentCo Holdings, 2024-CV-0493'. The brief must incorporate Victoria Sang's claim construction chart showing the parties' competing constructions for "dynamically reconfiguring" and "interconnect module," and address the file wrapper estoppel argument from the prosecution history showing PatentCo narrowed US Patent No. 10,234,567 (inventor Allan Park) to distinguish the Nakamura IEEE 2005 prior art reference. Reference the Chen prior art patent (US 6,892,101) that was cited during prosecution. Complete all actions using the available tools — do not just describe what you would do.
